name: Lackawanna County, PA
findings: Lackawanna County has 727 nonprofit organizations. 329 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 264 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lackawanna County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
